title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park — Episode4 An Idol's Tutelage

meta.Event Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Line: SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
There's so much we can do.
I'm not sure where to start...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, there really is a lot.
Since we're here, why don't we try something that we don't usually get to do?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Something that we don't usually get to do...? Oh, how about this...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Rollerblading...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure you can handle that, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think so...
I remember doing some roller skating when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then, you should be fine.
What do you two think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That sounds good.
I don't think I've done any roller skating since elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Same!
Alright, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, they seem to fit okay.
I should take a pic of them since they look so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright...
Oh, I can still stand up okay.
se_event_sports_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was actually a little worried since it's been so long...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been a while for me too, so I know how you feel. I also used to do this a lot when I was a kid.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Luckily, muscle memory seems to be working in our favor. Now, where's Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Sorry! Tying the laces is taking me longer than expected! Go ahead and start without me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's okay. Take your time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, where's Kanade?
She said she'd done this before when she was little...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: J-Just hang onto the wall... And slowly stand up...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
K-Kanade?
Your knees are shaking... Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm fine... My body still remembers this part...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Remember what part?!
Hold on. Were you originally just not very good at this...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay...
The wall... As long as I have the wall... I'll be... Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh no! I lost my grip on the wall...!
E-Ena...! Ena...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
N-No, wait! Kanade!
I can't handle going that fast either...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: W-Wah...!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
K-Kanade?!
Are you okay? You tumbled like a cartoon character just now...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did you get hurt?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm okay... Thankfully, I had my helmet on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
But this might not be the best way for us to increase our stamina...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone!
se_event_sports_2022_005
se_event_sports_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's start skating!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?! Kanade, did you fall?!
Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes... I'm okay, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Minori, how are you this good at skating...?! You even threw in a turn there just now, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's incredible. I had no idea you were so good at this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
Hehe. My face is turning red from all this praise...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This one audition I tried for a long time ago required us to be able to “dance while roller skating”, so I practiced a lot for it. As a result, I know the basics pretty well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I didn't end up passing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
You did all that just for an audition?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you get asked to do different things depending on the audition. Some need you to speak English or be able to do martial arts or programming and other sorts of special skills...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even programming...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, becoming an idol sounds really tough...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Practicing for auditions like that was never easy, and I couldn't pass any of them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I'm really glad I tried.
Because I think everything I've experienced is all a part of learning how to “give everyone hope for a better tomorrow”!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Everything you've experienced...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. That's really inspiring, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! No, it really isn't!
And I'm still just getting on my feet!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Kanade, are you okay? Can you stand?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay, but...
How do I actually do that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on. Why don't you have Minori teach you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She's really good at this, so I'm sure you'll be skating in no time once you learn some tips and tricks from her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
As it stands, I'll be stuck clinging to the wall... And not actually able to stand on my own...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hanasato, would you mind teaching me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Understood...!
In that case, I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here, grab on!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, let's give it a try together!
First, we'll work on learning how to stand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's actually a certain posture you can take that makes it harder for you to fall while wearing these!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, there is...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I fell a lot in the beginning too, so I did some research.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... You can keep your hand on the wall, but try to spread your legs out a little. About shoulder width should work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Shoulder width...? O-Okay, done...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, try bending your knees a bit, shift your weight a little forward and you should feel a lot steadier!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Bend my knees... Shift my weight forward...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I do feel a little steadier...!
Maybe I can let go of the wall now...
se_event_sports_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm up...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're doing great, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?! Already?!
Just a second ago, you were wobblier than a newborn fawn...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Look at that.
Minori, you're a really great teacher...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, let's try walking now!
You've done well so far, so I'm sure you'll get the hang of this really quickly!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
Having someone coach me like this is so nice.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me of when...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, I'll teach you how to throw the ball now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We did that together...)

rows.Speaker: Boys
rows.Line:
Hey, quit pushing!
It isn't safe!

rows.Speaker: Boys
rows.Line:
Relax!
It's more fun if you're going fast, right?!

rows.Speaker: Boys
rows.Line: Whoa...! If you dodge so suddenly like that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh?!
W-Wah...!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Th-They ran into me...!
I'm going too fast...!!)
se_event_sports_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! Kanade...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade!
se_event_sports_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I... I can't stop...!
What do I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm going to crash into the wall...)
se_event_sports_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kanadeeee!!
I'm coming!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You're not going to make it...!
se_event_sports_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh no! I'm going to crash..!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ena! I'm gonna grab Kanade and pass her to you! Please stay right there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: P-Pass her to me?!
se_event_sports_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Gotcha! And... Go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Whoa...!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Uhh...
Huh? Wh-What just happened?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Minori saved you, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... But I ended up taking a tumble in the end...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Hanasato...!
Are you hurt? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm okay!
I trip and fall a lot during dance practices, so this is nothing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-Is that really the issue here...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, thank goodness you weren't hurt too bad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a quick break and give it another try!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think you got the hang of walking just now, Kanade, so you should be skating on your own really soon!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll keep trying my best.
